entries.description: Authored ai-assignment.md via route(task_type=analysis) per Step 3.5.

Read AccessNode model, SaveAsTextTranslator, AccessTextParser, GeometryEnricher, LabelResolver, MacroActionsEnricher, VbaSignatureEnricher. Discovered the new AccessHarvester.Access project that already defines typed FormMetadata/ReportMetadata records with RecordSource/GroupLevels already promoted but lacks FormMetadataExtractor/ReportMetadataExtractor.

dotnet build clean (0 errors, 321 pre-existing warnings). dotnet test: 1219 passing, 45 pre-existing SymbolDb failures (Northwind comprehension-ir fixture not present locally — documented baseline matches main), 2 [SkippableFact] integration tests skipped (Access COM).

Routed analysis(complexity_hint=60) comparing current AccessNode ir/ shape vs YAML baseline vs aspirational FormMetadata/ReportMetadata typed schema. Findings: spec premise is materially miscalibrated. RecordSource not a gap vs YAML (both have it in Properties). Embedded-macro correlation already closed by MacroActionsEnricher. Real gap is vs aspirational typed schema. Recommended path: Option B — write FormMetadataExtractor/ReportMetadataExtractor following table-extractor-coverage pattern.

Wrote audit-findings.md (session-set root) summarising current AccessNode ir/ schema, gap-by-gap audit vs YAML and vs typed FormMetadata/ReportMetadata schema. Strategic question surfaced: Option A (narrow in-place fix per spec) vs Option B (write Form/ReportMetadataExtractor following table-extractor-coverage pattern). Recommend Option B. Also fixed the spec deliverable-path footgun (was session-reviews/session-001.md → now audit-findings.md, per lessons-learned).

Routed cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4). ISSUES_FOUND: 3 Minor — (1) ai-assignment.md Session 1 actuals had placeholders, (2) ai-assignment.md Session 2 plan still assumed Option A, (3) audit-findings.md §5 had Procedures contract inconsistency.
Re-routed cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4) after fixing all three Round 1 issues. VERIFIED — all three fixes confirmed real and complete, no new issues introduced.
Cross-provider code review on FormMetadataExtractor + ReportMetadataExtractor + AccessObjectReader + SyntheticMetadataExtractorIntegrationTests extension
Verified Session 1 committed (commit 3f3cdf0 + bbac4e3 + 4e1ffc7). Pre-existing modifications to samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb + samples/MiniComplex.accdb noted as out of session-set scope.

Re-read audit-findings.md, ai-assignment.md, FormMetadata/ReportMetadata/AccessObjectCommon typed contracts, TableMetadataExtractor + QueryMetadataExtractor precedent patterns, AccessTextParser + GeometryEnricher + LabelResolver + PropertyDecoder enricher outputs, and 09-report-grouping-events.expected.json aspirational fixture.

Created AccessHarvester.Access/FormMetadataExtractor.cs (94 lines) following TableMetadataExtractor precedent. Exact-value lifts of RecordSource/Filter/OrderBy with removal from Properties bag; DefaultView decoded with raw retained; Children recursively built into AccessControl tree via AccessObjectReader helper. ModuleName left null (deferred — would parse Attribute VB_Name from VbaCode in a future session). Procedures intentionally not modeled per FormMetadata.cs L122-129.

Created AccessHarvester.Access/ReportMetadataExtractor.cs (135 lines) + shared AccessHarvester.Access/AccessObjectReader.cs (helpers). Mirrors FormMetadataExtractor for shared fields plus GroupLevels construction: scans Children for GroupLevel<N>Header/Footer sections (HasHeader/HasFooter) and root Properties for GroupLevel<N> field expressions (GroupOn). PageSetup stubbed null (deferred per spec). Per-level GroupingMode/Interval/SortOrder/KeepTogether left null (deferred — no real-fixture evidence to confirm raw shape; Session 3 hermetic unit tests can fabricate inputs).

Extended SyntheticMetadataExtractorIntegrationTests with Forms + Reports added to validated category list; AssertForms/AssertReports follow the existing loose-match pattern (index by Name, verify scalar fields, walk named controls recursively). Added ReadNamedActualCategory helper that derives the form/report name from the .ir.json file name. AssertGroupLevels comparator wired in for report-side validation against the 09-report-grouping-events.expected.json fixture.

dotnet build clean (4 NU1903 transitive-dep warnings, 0 errors). dotnet test: 1219 active tests passing across AccessHarvester.Tests (350P/2S — 2 SkippableFact integration tests skipped because Access COM not present in this run), AccessHarvester.Pipeline.Tests (355P), AccessHarvester.Vba.Resolver.Tests (400P), AccessHarvester.Sql.Grammar.Tests (85P), AccessHarvester.Integration (14P). 45 pre-existing AccessHarvester.SymbolDb.Tests failures driven by missing tmp/comprehension-ir/AccessMetaData/NorthwindDevEdition/ Northwind comprehension-ir fixture (documented baseline matching main). No new regressions.

Applied two real bugs (Critical/Major) and one minor surfaced by Step 6 Sonnet code-review (gemini-pro verifier VERIFIED): (1) Reports DefaultView codes are a separate enumeration from Forms — added ReportMetadataExtractor.DefaultViewLabels (0=Report View, 1=Print Preview, 2=Layout View) so a report rptFoo with DefaultView="1" no longer decodes as "Continuous Forms"; (2) GroupLevel<N> keys are exact-value lifts and must be removed from the Properties bag after promotion — refactored BuildGroupLevels to collect consumed keys into a HashSet that augments PromotedRootKeys before BuildPromotedPropertiesBag runs; (3) removed dead ReadInt helper from AccessObjectReader. Added inline NOTE on BuildGroupLevels documenting the unverified-yet GroupLevel<N>-as-flat-key assumption from the audit recommendation; the SkippableFact integration test will fail loudly against a live Access extract if the key shape is actually nested. Re-built clean.
Cross-provider session-verification routed to gpt-5-4. Raw output saved to session-reviews/session-002.md.

Round 2 cross-provider session-verification routed to gpt-5-4 after fixing Round 1 Major issue (AssertForms/AssertReports unconditional scalar comparison). Raw output saved to session-reviews/session-002.round-2.md.
Routed analysis for Session 3 next-orchestrator recommendation.
